scope: Source traceability of latest user requirement: coordinate other leads and show actual takes in dashboard

observations.fact: Registered task assignments derive from available ledger claims, exclude released, and expose branch/worktree source mismatch; unavailable is null rather than no owner.
Active claims with no registered task are separately exposed, so taken work is not silently hidden.
A take is checked against active task/worktree/scope conflicts before transaction commit and receipt; request replay is payload-bound.
Card differentiates unknown, no registered take, taken, pending handoff, stale still occupied, and source mismatch.
Details display claim ID/version, Lead/Worker, role/state, branch/worktree, literal scopes, origin and update/verification time.
Coordination DB unavailable returns unknown with explicit do-not-take semantics, never free or released.

conclusion: Current source has a single-ledger path from committed claim to user-visible take details; manager must keep new tasks NOT_TAKEN until real committed receipt and registered owner source. No new parallel manual status table needed.
